leadText:
Robert's grandfather (Japanese: ロバートの祖父 Robert's grandfather) is a character of the day who appeared during 's flashbacks in The Four Seasons of Sawsbuck!.

He was a Pokémon photographer who traveled around the . His grandson Robert admired his grandfather's works, particularly a photo of all four of in one place. After showing and his grandfather's album, they agreed to help Robert replicate the rare snapshot.
